sites.evidence_type: published tag insertion in the same loop or domain
sites.functional_impact_measured: Surface staining: anti-Myc antibody labeled the cell periphery and cell-cell junctions in transfected cells without permeabilization, confirming extracellular display of the tag on the full-length protein. Protocadherin adhesion or signaling function was NOT MEASURED.
sites.rationale: L1 and L2 explicitly place the Myc tag in the stalk region between EC6 and the TM helix of a γC3 (PCDHGA5-family) full-length construct; L3/L4 confirm surface display by live-cell anti-Myc staining. The stalk spans approximately residues 650–692 in PCDHGA5 canonical numbering (extracellular domain 30–692, TM 693–713), providing ample space for a ~13–23 aa insert well away from the TM boundary. No specific residue is named in any ledger clip, so insert_after_residue is left null per the named-loop rule. Full-length, membrane-anchored γC3 (PCDHGA5-family) construct with a Myc tag inserted into the extracellular stalk region between EC6 and the TM helix, co-expressed with an intracellular fluorescent protein; anti-Myc antibody applied to live, non-permeabilized transfected cells.

sources.claim: For derived constructs including the myc tag, the tag was positioned in the stalk region between EC6 and the transmembrane helix ( Figure S1A ), equivalently to previously validated constructs ( 21 ).

literature_notes: All six ledger clips (L1–L6) describe the same experimental system: a Myc-tagged, full-length γC3 (PCDHGA5-family) cPCDH construct with the tag in the extracellular stalk between EC6 and the TM helix. L1 and L2 describe the position; L3 and L4 report the surface-staining validation; L5 and L6 describe the experimental design. Because all clips converge on one region with no residue-level resolution, only one site is reported. The γC3 isoform (PCDHGC3) is not identical to PCDHGA5 but is annotated in the ledger as 'PCDHGA5-family'; the stalk region is structurally conserved across gamma-protocadherin isoforms. No ledger clip names a specific residue, so the site is region-level (insert_after_residue null). No intracellular or function-abrogating positions were reported in the ledger.
